posts.t:
Pageau gets on a shorthanded breakaway and does a good job to protect the puck. Draws a holding penalty from Heiskanen. 4-on-4 coming with 5:28 to go in the second. 

Gets Schaefer back on the ice. 

3-2 DAL. 

#Isles

Holmstrom changes as DAL rushes up the ice. DAL gets a cycle and Pelech takes a hooking penalty that he probably has to take to eliminate a goal-scoring chance. Back to the PK with 5:55 to go in the second. 

Down 3-2.

Stanley absolutely drills Rantanen into the end boards. Then Stanley has some words for Rantanen after he gets up. 

#Isles to the PK with 10:53 to go in the second.
Holmstrom lets Hintz walk right by him. Sorokin closes the five-hole and holds on with 14:51 to go in the second. 2-2. #Isles

#Isles down 2-1 after the opening period. 

Schaefer hands down NYI's best player. I think Eklund, quietly, had a really good period. Gap control was an issue early. Puck management was an issue at times. Everyone needs to be a bit better in the second.

Schaefer's having to do everything out there in this first period. He's going 200 feet every shift and making the plays, minus the 2-on-1 that Stanley played correctly. 

#Isles
Schaefer hits the post. #Isles

After Schaefer's mesmerizing goal, Robertson gives DAL a 2-1 lead with 5:28 to go in the first. 

Schenn turnover and Robertson, from behind the goal, just walks to the front and roofs one glove side on Sorokin. #Isles
Goals in back-to-back games for Schaefer. #Isles
Matthew Schaefer. 1-1 with 6:17 to go. 4-on-4. Blew by Johnston and roofed one on Oettinger. That was something. #Isles

Schaefer just took a puck off the goal line. Ref blows it dead because he lost sight of it. Then, Copabianco shoots the puck into the net after the whistle. 

#Isles jump him. Copabianco gets two minutes for unsportsmanlike conduct. 

PP with 6:41 to go in the first.
Sorokin never got square to the shot.
#Isles get no shots on the PP. Horvat had a look. Duclair had best look but couldn't finish in front of goal as he tried to wrap puck around Oettinger's right pad.
Schaefer with a no-look laser pass to Horvat up the left side but he missed the net by an inch. Sneaky pass. #Isles

#Isles to the PP with 11:56 to go in the first. Whistles blows after Kessel one-timer after Bichsel took shot to stomach. Bischsel goes off for tripping. 

Strong forecheck by NYI drew penalty.

Holmstrom with #Isles first shot with 12:50 to play in the first. 

NYI got that chance after Schaefer, easily, poked puck off Robertson's stick.
Sorokin gloves a Heiskanen shot and holds on. Shots 4-0 DAL with 14:00 to play in the first. #Isles not having much luck in transition and look shaky defensively.
DAL giving #Isles fits early on in NYI zone. Twice now, NYI have left DAL players wide open. Sorokin sharp early.

#Isles starters vs. #TexasHockey:

MacLean-Cizikas-Chaffee
Schaefer-Stanley
Sorokin

DeBoer has started this line for three straight games.

#Isles warm-up lines vs. #TexasHockey @bullsmithsli: 

Holmstrom-Horvat-Palmieri
Heineman-Schenn-Eklund
Palat-Pageau-Duclair
MacLean-Cizikas-Chaffee

Stanley-Schaefer
Pelech-Pulock
Kessel-DeAngelo

Sorokin 
Varlamov
